tags.name: Conch dive site
tags.depth_range: 14m (bow) to 21m (stern); prior single value of ~22m was unsourced
tags.qa_note: SS Conch: 1892-built, 3,555-ton Shell tanker, W. Gray & Co, Stockton; struck rock off Akurala and broke in two carrying bulk oil cargo Novorossisk-Colombo-Madras. Sources conflict on exact sinking date (June 2 vs June 3, 1903) and the rock's exact name (Akurala/Akarta/Parsi-Passa gala) -- both conflicts stated explicitly in markdown rather than resolved by guessing. Single-source 'explosion/dynamite' claim noted as unconfirmed, not fact. 'Queen angelfish' (non-Indian-Ocean species) removed as a likely copy-paste error from aggregator blogs.

tags.name: Goddamahagale dive site

Name closely resembles 'Goda Maha Gala', named in Negombo operator site rosters, and a third-party database lists a 'Maha Gala' ~7.6km away -- plausibly related but not confirmed as the same site. Fabricated claims of hard corals, sea fans, lionfish, scorpionfish, wrasse, reliable turtles, and reef octopus removed. Downgraded from a prior 'validated: true' sourced only to the generic tag 'perplexity'.

tags.name: Unuwatuna Coral Reef
tags.qa_note: Re-audited 2026-07-03: no dive-shop or forum source names this exact reef polygon; only bay-level (Unawatuna Bay generally) sourcing was found (thesrilankanguideline.com, sundivingsrilanka.com, pearldiverslk.com), which does not meet the site-specific 3-source bar, so validated was downgraded from a prior true (originally sourced only to the generic tag 'web_research'). The 'known_wrecks: SS Rangoon' tag previously on this entry was removed as incorrect -- SS Rangoon rests at 30-32m near the mouth of Galle Harbour, roughly 2-3km away, and is a distinct, separate dive site. Prior 'coral bleaching' claim likely conflated 2004 tsunami physical damage (a real, sourced phenomenon here) with bleaching (a different phenomenon, unsourced for this site) and was removed. Hawksbill-at-8-15m, chromis schools, porcupinefish, and nudibranch claims specific to this site were unsourced and removed.
